core_obligations: Preserve sufficiently large polynomial time bound, honest fixed-length queries, and inverse polynomial advantage.
Retain the full typical-sample hitting-set compression argument and probability grouping.
Retain complete tally-language reduction, derandomization and author footnote on query lengths; full earlier AM containment proof supplied as context.
difficulty_reason: The authors use hitting sets whose seed length has coefficient one on log(1/epsilon) to bound time-bounded complexity by sample surprise, then union-bound over probability groups. This transfers a putative SAT reduction to unbounded Kolmogorov complexity on tally languages, enabling AM derandomization and a NE/coNE consequence.
